metadata.name: Gudit k6 concurrency performance fixtures
metadata.warning: The bundled JWT secret and tokens are test-only. Never use them in production.

schedulerInitialization.behavior: Performance fixtures are preloaded in ON_SALE state for immediate test execution.

users.reason: 1,000 unique VUs plus one duplicate-purchase actor, one cancellation actor, one payment-confirm actor, and one payment-confirm-cancel actor

goods.reason: one goods row per sale fixture

sales.reason: two hotspot fixtures, 100 distributed fixtures, and three race-condition fixtures

purchases.reason: pending purchases used by the concurrent cancellation and payment-confirm tests

payments.reason: READY payments paired with the cancellation and payment-confirm test purchases

accessTokens.reason: authenticated k6 requests without invoking Kakao OAuth during the measured run

oversellHotspot.description: 1,000 unique users compete for 100 units on one locked sale row.

singleRowLockCapacity.description: 1,000 unique users compete on one sale with sufficient stock to expose lock queue latency.

distributedBaseline.description: The same 1,000 users are spread evenly over 100 Redis stock keys to provide a distributed baseline.

duplicatePurchaseRace.description: One authenticated user fires 50 concurrent requests at the same sale.
duplicatePurchaseRace.riskNote: Concurrent duplicate requests may be rejected either by the database duplicate check or by the Redis per-user purchase limit.

cancelRace.description: One authenticated user fires 50 concurrent cancels for the same pending purchase.
cancelRace.riskNote: The Purchase pessimistic lock and status revalidation must ensure that Redis stock is restored exactly once.

paymentConfirmRace.description: One authenticated user fires 50 concurrent payment confirmation requests for the same READY payment.
paymentConfirmRace.riskNote: Concurrent confirmation requests must not complete the same payment more than once or corrupt the Purchase and Payment state.

paymentConfirmCancelRace.description: One payment confirmation request and one purchase cancellation request race against the same pending purchase.
paymentConfirmCancelRace.riskNote: Payment confirmation and purchase cancellation must not deadlock or leave Payment, Purchase, and Redis stock in inconsistent states.
